Current desktop Chrome microphone input selector and specific-site permissions; managed browser settings may require administrator. No broad allow-all-sites recommendation.
Physical connections, USB port comparisons, mute and gradually adjusted input level. BIOS/driver procedures on source page are not reproduced.

Dell combo TRRS versus separate headphone/microphone plugs; call app input is independent of Windows default; save work before normal restart and offered Windows updates. Guide stops before advanced driver, firmware and restore/reset procedures; no hardware diagnostic certainty claimed.
Consequences only: Keep my files removes apps/settings; Remove everything also removes personal files. No reset instructions reproduced.

decisions: Choose and record one named input before treating a Windows test as relevant to a headset or call. Playback output is checked before interpreting an inaudible sample.
Decorative three-stage voice path supports the Windows/app/other-person diagnosis; all substantive information stays in ordinary text.
Two native disclosures explain TRRS combo versus separate plugs and desktop-app permission scope/exceptions. No article JavaScript or recording/upload widget.
App input can differ from Windows default; Teams test call is conditional and absent on web. Personal-use device settings linked separately.
Use the actual trusted meeting site, not blanket website access. Managed settings go to the administrator; no security, management or registry bypass.
Keep test speech harmless and private; save work before restart; explain Keep my files versus Remove everything consequences and stop before reset, reinstall or driver removal.
Source-based organization attribution with no fabricated device tests, experience or repair promise. Article/review dates October 30; no claim manufacturers revised their sources today.
Preserve authoritative Hailey hours and all related regression coverage; no account, security, hosting, tracking or affiliate changes.
